thread:
Nina: Quick pulse  the launch post drove good clicks but dashboard shows webinar signups up and demo requests flat. can we unpack?
Owen: saw that too. CTR on the launch post bundle is +38% vs baseline. link to post analytics: https://analytics.redwood/launch/4532
Samir: my hunch is inbound routing + attribution window. are we still using last-touch 7d for the weekly KPI?
Gwen: yes we are. that was the default change last month for headline simplicity.
Kara (Revenue Ops): note: SDR routing rules depend on utm_campaign normalization. if variants slip they can go to wrong queues which affects demo conversion.
Nina: thanks Kara. can we get a quick count of distinct utm_campaign strings tied to the launch this week?
metrics-bot: KPI snapshot updated: "Weekly Marketing" dashboard refreshed by Samir :bar_chart:
Samir: running query now, short snippet:```SELECT utm_campaign, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM marketing.leads WHERE campaign_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50;```
Owen: while analytics runs, note we pushed two slightly different post CTAs: one asked "watch webinar" and the other "request demo". we split-test copy in the feed.
Gwen: ah that explains part of it. split CTA will segment traffic. which CTA mapped to the webinar landing vs demo form?
Owen: CTA A (watch webinar) -> webinar LP. CTA B (request demo) -> product trial LP. but some partners override utm_campaign on syndication which complicates attribution.
Kara (Revenue Ops): can we hold SDR outreach for any leads that have conflicting utm strings until we dedupe? last week we had 43 dup outreach incidents.
Samir: query finished. found 6 utm_campaign variants pointing to the launch, total 2,940 leads. top two variants account for 88%. 3 variants are <1% each.
Nina: action list: (1) normalize utm_campaign at ingestion (lowercase + alias mapping), (2) rehydrate/dedupe today's leads and produce CSV for SDRs, (3) add annotation and small table in weekly deck showing attribution windows.
Gwen: on attribution windows: can we compute last-touch 7d vs first-touch 30d for the launch cohort? execs want clarity on whether webinar is undercounted.
Samir: yes. running both cohorts now. quick CLI snippet:```-- cohort compare
WITH c AS (SELECT user_id, first_touch, last_touch FROM marketing.attribution WHERE campaign='launch-2026')
SELECT 'first_30d' as method, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM c WHERE first_touch BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
UNION ALL
SELECT 'last_7d', COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM c WHERE last_touch BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE();```
metrics-bot: export ready: https://bigquery.cloud.redwood/exports/launch-cohort-193555.csv (read-only)
Kara (Revenue Ops): i'll pause outreach for flagged leads and notify SDR leads. please deliver CSV and mark rows with dedupe_id so we can reconcile.
Owen: small experiment request: keep headline metric as last-touch 7d, but add a stability metric (first-touch 30d) in the deck. also surface CTA variant performance side-by-side.
Nina: agree. don't change headline mid-period. add both visuals and a 1-sentence note explaining differences.
Samir: cohort results: first-touch 30d shows +14% trial growth for launch cohort, last-touch 7d shows +1%. that suggests delayed conversion pattern. uploading viz to dashboard.
Gwen: sweet. also, messaging iteration  we should tweak the launch post CTA for the next paid push. brief: favor webinar CTA for top-funnel posts, demo CTA for remarketing.
Owen: I'll draft 2 new CTA variants and route through LiveRamp test next run.
Kara (Revenue Ops): rehydrate job done, merged 512 duplicates. CSV posted to https://bigquery.cloud.redwood/exports/launch-dedupe-193555.csv. SDRs notified.
Nina: thanks team. last item: add a pinned note on the KPI dashboard and a short blurb for the exec slide explaining the cause + mitigations. can someone own the deck blurb?
Gwen: i'll take the deck blurb and share in this thread for quick sign-off.
Samir: updated dashboard with annotation and link to both CSVs. closing loop in tomorrow's KPI huddle. :white_check_mark:
